mapper.select: SELECT fingerprint, revision FROM sync_request WHERE account_id = #{account} AND request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sync_record WHERE account_id = #{account} AND record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sync_record (account_id, record_id, kind, body, revision) VALUES (#{account}, #{recordId}, #{kind}, #{body}, #{revision})
INSERT INTO sync_request (account_id, request_id, fingerprint, revision) VALUES (#{account}, #{requestId}, #{fingerprint}, #{revision})
